svg.title: Separate walking support from carrying bags
svg.desc: Left: a load placed high and forward in a rollator shifts its center of gravity. Right: Maknae follows and carries the bags while the older adult walks with a cane.

g.font-family: Pretendard, Noto Sans CJK KR, NanumGothic, sans-serif
g.text: One device supports walking and carries the bags
The older adult balances with a cane
Example with the load high and forward
Maknae carries the bags so the person can hold the cane
